verify_detail: -start count (`priorCount % 5 ∈ {2,4}`), which only resets when app data is cleared. A UI test that doesn't control for this counter (e.g., doesn't `pm clear` before each run, or runs in a suite where prior test runs already bumped the counter) will hit the hidden state on 2 of every 5 cold starts — explaining the ~60% pass rate. Fix: either assert conditionally on `launchCount % 5`, or clear app data immediately before the test so the launch is always prior-count 0 (deterministically visible)."
